provenance.user_defined: S/zigzag outline with a shaft connected at the middle and no lower horizontal return. Upper concave faces push; lower concave faces hook and pull. Both wrists use this fixed part.
provenance.source_dimensions: User-approved sketch, 2026-10-24: 42.5 mm from shaft lower surface to lowest edge, equal working edges of 29.466 mm, width 20 mm, thickness 4 mm; 16 x 10 mm flat-sided shaft hole and 8 mm upper circular hole.
provenance.assumptions: 45-degree bends, 4mm thickness and steel density7800kg/m3 remain modelling assumptions. Holes are actual faceted through openings; shaft junction trimmed to avoid duplicate material.
provenance.frame: +X is the 20mm extrusion width, Y points up in the side sketch, +Z goes from wrist toward tool tip. A common Z shift places the foremost outer edge at the configured 104.83578643762691mm forward extent; no horizontal return is added.

wrist_mount.material_assumption: Steel, same assumed density as the S tool.
wrist_mount.placement: Cylinder front face is at the hand/S-shaft origin (wrist z=100.1 mm); rear face is at wrist z=94.5 mm.
wrist_mount.geometry_note: One solid cylinder defines visual and collision geometry. Mass and inertia are calculated for this fixed body. The cylinder seats about 1 mm inside the wrist visual shell.
wrist_mount.role: Fixed wrist connection, separate from the tool end. Mount contacts are recorded separately in S-tool working-face records.

through_holes.method: disjoint convex pieces around true holes; visual and collision identical; mass from remaining volume
